title: Dynamic Programming
subtitle: Watch overlapping subproblems build bottom-up, inspect state dependencies, and trace back optimal solutions.

fibonacci-dp.name: Fibonacci (Tabulation)
fibonacci-dp.shortDesc: 1D bottom-up table showing how F(i) reuses F(i−1) and F(i−2).
fibonacci-dp.complexityNote: Bottom-up tabulation eliminates exponential O(2ⁿ) recursion · O(1) space possible with two rolling variables

knapsack-01.name: 0/1 Knapsack
knapsack-01.shortDesc: 2D item-by-capacity table comparing skip vs. take with optimal subset traceback.
knapsack-01.complexityNote: Pseudo-polynomial in capacity W · Backtracking recovers the exact optimal item subset

lcs.name: Longest Common Subsequence
lcs.shortDesc: 2D alignment grid with diagonal matches, mismatch choices, and subsequence reconstruction.
lcs.complexityNote: m, n = string lengths · Diagonal transition on match, max(up, left) on mismatch

coin-change-dp.name: Coin Change (Min Coins)
coin-change-dp.shortDesc: 1D minimum-coin table initialized to ∞ that succeeds even where greedy fails.
coin-change-dp.complexityNote: n = denominations, A = target amount · Guarantees the global minimum coin count

controls.itemsHint: Comma-separated, up to 6 items, e.g. A:1:1, B:3:4, C:4:5, D:5:7

errors.invalidInput: Please check your input values and try again.
errors.invalidItems: Enter 1–6 items formatted as Name:Weight:Value with positive integer weights.

steps.fibInit: Initialize 1D DP table of size {{size}} for Fibonacci({{n}}).
steps.knapsackInit: Initialize ({{rows}} × {{cols}}) table with zeros for {{count}} items and capacity {{capacity}}.
steps.knapsackNoFit: Item {{item}} (weight {{weight}}) exceeds capacity {{w}}; carry forward skip value {{skipVal}}.
steps.knapsackTake: Item {{item}} at w={{w}}: taking ({{takeVal}}) beats skipping ({{skipVal}}) → dp[{{i}}][{{w}}] = {{best}}.
steps.knapsackSkip: Item {{item}} at w={{w}}: skipping ({{skipVal}}) ≥ taking ({{takeVal}}) → dp[{{i}}][{{w}}] = {{best}}.
steps.knapsackTraceTake: Traceback at ({{i}}, {{w}}): include {{item}} (w={{weight}}, v={{value}}) and jump to capacity {{nextW}}.
steps.knapsackTraceSkip: Traceback at ({{i}}, {{w}}): value came from above, so exclude {{item}}.
steps.lcsMatch: Characters match ('{{chA}}' = '{{chB}}'): extend diagonal to dp[{{i}}][{{j}}] = {{value}}.
steps.lcsTraceMatch: Traceback at ({{i}}, {{j}}): matched '{{ch}}' — record it and step diagonally.
steps.lcsTraceUp: Traceback at ({{i}}, {{j}}): move up to row {{nextI}}.
steps.lcsTraceLeft: Traceback at ({{i}}, {{j}}): move left to column {{nextJ}}.
steps.coinInit: Initialize dp[0] = 0 and dp[1..{{amount}}] = ∞ using coins [{{coins}}].
steps.coinFill: Amount {{amount}}: using coin {{coin}} from dp[{{prev}}] yields minimum {{value}} coins.
steps.coinUnreachableCell: Amount {{amount}}: no coin reaches this value yet — remains ∞.
steps.coinTrace: Traceback at amount {{current}}: take coin {{coin}}, leaving {{next}}.
steps.coinDone: Done! Minimum coins for {{amount}} is {{minCoins}} using [{{picked}}].
steps.coinDoneUnreachable: Done! Target {{amount}} cannot be formed with coins [{{coins}}].
